subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• "The Lottery" is a short story.
• It was written by American author Shirley Jackson.
• It was first published in The New Yorker magazine in 1948.
• It is written in third person omniscient perspective.
• It takes place in a small New England village.
prompt: The student wants to indicate where the short story takes place. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: "The Lottery" was published in The New Yorker magazine.
choices.B: "The Lottery" is written in third person omniscient perspective.
choices.C: "The Lottery" takes place in a small New England village.
choices.D: "The Lottery" was written by Shirley Jackson.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence indicates where "The Lottery" takes place, stating that it takes place in a small New England village.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence indicates the point of view used in "The Lottery"; it doesn't indicate where the story takes place.
